data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month, an individual opt-in—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 adds $8,000 if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed. This assumes those catches; other choices need recalculation. Intentions aren't binding; long-run gains aren't assured.
